_note: Starter glossary. Add terms incrementally as native-speaker spot-checks surface them. Loaded as a cached prompt prefix (zero per-call cost after first request).

terms.rule: Name of the WooCommerce POS feature. Prefer keeping it in English (or the locale's industry-standard English term) rather than a literal calque; Russian translations of this term as 'point where goods are given' have caused confusion.
Use the locale's established commerce term where one exists (e.g. de: Gutschein, fr: Code promo). Do not keep in English by default.
Shipping label flag for hazardous materials. Use the locale's regulated term (e.g. de: Gefahrgut).
Stock keeping unit. Keep as 'SKU' in all locales.
